text:
marta: Hey team, quick weekly run-through of GPU burn by region. Looks like EU-west spike overnight: +28% GPU-hours vs last week. Can we confirm nodes and any packet loss?
ryan: Seeing higher KV cache miss rate on euw1, adds ~0.8ms/token latency. No packet drops in VPC, but NPU driver pod restarted twice.
song: euw1 cluster kubelet memory pressure flapped at 03:14, OOMKilled one sidecar. Recycled rack-3 node pool (g3-rack3). Rebooted 03:22.
marta: Good catch. What's current reserve? We had 120 reserved GPUs in EU baseline, plus 40 burst. Are we within burst budget?
devon: After the reboot and scheduled jobs, EU used 158/160 reserved+burst for a ~2h window. Peak throughput 12.3k tokens/s aggregated. We dipped into spot pool for ~25 GPUs.
ryan: Spot reclaim rate was acceptable but latency jitter went up. Autoscaler scaled spot group from 25->45 but cooldown delayed new pods by ~90s.
autoscaler-bot: [alert] euw1 autoscaler cooldown exceeded threshold (90s). Suggested scale-policy: allow 2 concurrent scale ops.
song: Ops note: kube-scheduler backlog hit 180 pending pods for ~7min during surge. That's the main cause of delay, not cloud attach time.
marta: Action items:
- song to mark g3-rack3 as degraded and schedule maintenance window tomorrow 02:00 UTC
- devon to raise burst budget to 60 for EU for next 72h to cover expected churn (approval from finance?)
- ryan to tune autoscaler cooldown and add a 2nd scale-op for euw1
- ops to run a simulated 35% spike on stg-euw to validate behavior
ryan: I'll open a PR for autoscaler change, but note this increases transient cost. Estimate +$1.7k/day if we permanently increase burst.
devon: Finance ok with 72h temporary bump; will need ticket for any longer than one week.
song: For capacity forecasts: EU projection for next week: base 110 GPUs, expected surge windows (Tue 03:00-06:00 UTC) +35 GPUs, Wed 15:00-18:00 UTC +20 GPUs. Total projected GPU-hours = "(110*24*7)+(35*3)+(20*3)" approx 18,720 GPU-hours; will refine.
marta: Can you paste the export? I want committed vs on-demand split.
song: Pasting CSV snippet:
```
region,base_committed,burst_history,last_7d_avg,projected_peak
euw,120,40,135,158
na,100,30,98,110
ap,30,10,28,35
```
marta: Thanks. Let's also consider a temporary quantization pilot on low-latency pipelines to cut token cost ~12%. If we pilot on 25 GPUs, projected savings ~$800/day.
devon: Agree. Schedule for Wed midnight for pilot. I'll coordinate infra + ML.
ryan: FYI I've queued a network-level check for euw1 to validate inter-rack latency. Will post results by EOD.
autoscaler-bot: [info] euw1 simulated scale test queued (50 pods) by ryan. ETA 23:00 UTC.
marta: Perfect. We'll reconvene after the stg run. End of thread.
